text: This major focuses on "light" as the core carrier, studying the interaction between light and matter, the generation and modulation of light signals, photovoltaic conversion technology, and the design and application of optical information systems. It covers multiple fields such as traditional optics (such as geometric optics, physical optics), modern optoelectronic technology (such as laser technology, optoelectronic devices), and information processing (such as optical communication, image processing), and is a key discipline that supports the development of modern technologies such as optical fiber communication, laser technology, optoelectronic display, and remote sensing detection.
